item.title: WATCH: Gallego grills DHS over ICE conduct after shocking videos
item.description: Sen. Ruben Gallego pressed Department of Homeland Security officials during a committee hearing over a string of videos showing federal ICE agents using force during arrests.

item.title: A city treasure: Tucson Gem and Mineral Show kicks off four-day event at TCC
item.description: While similarly named showcases take place throughout the city, the Tucson Gem and Mineral Show is the first and oldest of them, tracing its roots back more than seven decades.

item.title: Citizens Police Academy offers an inside look at Marana Police operations
item.description: The Marana Police Department is offering the community an in-depth look at the department’s operations through its Citizens Police Academy. The deadline to apply is Monday, February 16.
